text:
How sad, O Spring,
how sad your joys are today!
Grieving maidens hurry
in an anxious throng,
tunics loosened,
hair disordered,
with mournful cries calling,
“Adonis! Adonis!”

The sunset dims the light,
and through valleys and woods
they go with red torches,
searching and calling.
Amid tears and laughter,
lament and clamor,
the sorrowing echo
repeats, “Adonis! Adonis!”

The handsomest youth,
the most loving young man,
lies among roses,
cold, pale, and still.
The purple of his veins
stains all the flowers,
and the air is filled
with the cry, “Adonis! Adonis!”

translation.title: Spring Festival
